judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is the Radio Roraima play button in the header: a 50x50 circle whose only content is a Font Awesome play glyph (aria-hidden); the 'Radio Roraima' h2 beside it is a separate element, not part of the control. claimTrue: the snapshot records the icon colour #ffffff from CSS and the circle #cccccc, 1.61:1, and the button shows nothing but the icon. elementFails: the live page's inline CSS sets .play-pause background-color #ccc and .play-pause i color #fff, so users get white on #ccc (1.61:1); the circle itself is also #ccc on the white header (1.61:1). The play glyph is the only visual cue of what the control does, so it is required to identify the component, and by G207's test (3:1 against the adjacent colour, the whole glyph is adjacent only to #ccc) it fails 1.4.11. captureDiffers: the screenshot is fully styled and the live HTML has the same markup and CSS for #player. The claim names exactly this failure. (Separately the button has no accessible name, a 4.1.2 issue.)

The tag is real informative text, not incidental or a logo. captureDiffers: the screenshot is styled and the live page still shows this card and tag with the same CSS. The claim names the failure.
